title: Research: general odd-kernel exclusion pattern for native DATA shear pairs (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Completes open question 2 of [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593) (`research/triadic-query-pair`, kernel-3 specialization of [#840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/840)): for every positive odd kernel `q`, the same three-query fusion at `a=±q·2^j` attains the typed invoice below on every **odd modulus coprime to `q`**. Even moduli and odd moduli sharing a prime with `q` are excluded. Typed costs do **not** improve over the dyadic (`q=1`) case.

```text
x <- h^-a x
x ^= y
x <- h^(2a) x
x ^= y
x <- h^-a x
```

| Complete cost item | Separate pair | Fused odd-kernel pair |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary recursive children | 4 | 3 |
| Ordered affine events | 24 | 18 |
| Aligned XOR scans | 4 | 2 |
| Extra full private rows | 0 | 0 |

Certificate kernels: `{1,3,5,7,9,15}` (dyadic recovery, triadic cross-check, and primary new `{5,7,9,15}`). Pattern: admitted ⇔ odd and `gcd(modulus,q)=1`.

**Research construction / recursive interface; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686) (including [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677), [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643), [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593)) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/odd-kernel-query-pair/`.
Tip: `c319093b5b96211e89165f4ad9dd0d20d5039414`.

Exact invoice **children 4→3; affine 24→18; XOR 4→2** uniformly across certified odd kernels; no typed gain over dyadic.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/odd-kernel-query-pair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/odd-kernel-query-pair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/odd-kernel-query-pair/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/odd-kernel-query-pair/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/odd-kernel-query-pair
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_ODD_KERNEL_QUERY_PAIR kernels=[1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 15] primary_new=[5, 7, 9, 15] children=4->3 affine=24->18 xor=4->2 no_typed_gain_over_dyadic ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_ODD_KERNEL_QUERY_PAIR kernels=[1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 15] ... no_new_kappa
PASS_ODD_KERNEL_QUERY_PAIR_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/odd-kernel-query-pair outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/840) dyadic; [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593) kernel-3 (OQ2). Freestanding generalization; does not edit those packages. No competing open PR on this multi-kernel pattern at refresh.
